safety.en: Most of the route follows pedestrian-friendly coastal paths and promenades, away from busy roads. Navigation is very straightforward, so there's little need to worry about traffic or getting lost.

scenery.en: Stunning Mediterranean views throughout the run, especially at sunrise. The scenery keeps changing between beaches, elevated coastal paths and the charming cafés and houses of La Cala de Mijas.

surface.en: Mostly flat and even, with long stretches of seaside promenade and coastal paths. A comfortable route for keeping a steady running rhythm without having to tackle the steep hills often found in Southern Europe.

experience.en: A beautiful and enjoyable coastal run with constantly changing scenery, stunning sunrise views and plenty of drinking fountains along the way. The perfect combination of easy running and exploring a new place.

en.title: Fuengirola: along the coast
en.excerpt: A mostly flat 15 km run from near Cabopino to Fuengirola, with changing coastal scenery, a sunrise over the Mediterranean and a pastry to finish.

practicalSummary.goodFor: A steady seaside run, sunrise views and a break from the hills.
practicalSummary.terrain: 15 km one way; mostly flat promenades, boardwalks and coastal paths.
practicalSummary.keepInMind: Start early in summer, share the path with walkers and plan your way back from Fuengirola.

en.body:
If you're not a big fan of the hills in Southern Europe, this might be the perfect running route for you!

## Follow the coastline

I started my 15 km run near Cabopino, between Marbella and Fuengirola, at sunrise and followed the coastline all the way to Fuengirola. The route is mostly flat, with a long seaside promenade that makes running feel easy and enjoyable. No need to worry about cars or traffic, just the sea and beautiful views along the way.

The best part is, it's almost impossible to get lost! Just follow the coastline and keep running. No need to constantly check your map or wonder where to turn next. You can simply switch off, enjoy the views and focus on your run.

![Boardwalks and coastal paths keep the scenery changing.](/assets/uploads/fuengirola/coastal-paths.jpg "Boardwalks and coastal paths keep the scenery changing.")

Even though the route follows the coastline for 15 km, it never gets boring. The scenery keeps changing along the way. Sometimes you're running right next to the beach, while other sections take you a little higher above the coastline, offering beautiful views of the Mediterranean. You also pass through the lovely town of La Cala de Mijas, running past little cafés, houses and streets that add a completely different atmosphere to the route. There's always something new to look at, which makes the kilometres fly by.

## Sunrise and sea views

One of my favourite things about this run was watching the sunrise. If you head towards Fuengirola early in the morning, you get to enjoy the sun coming up as you run. Especially during the summer months, starting early is definitely worth it, not only for the views but also for the cooler temperatures.

![An early start comes with its own reward.](/assets/uploads/fuengirola/sunrise.jpg "An early start comes with its own reward.")

Another thing I really appreciated was the number of drinking fountains along the route. Being able to stop for a drink or cool down without carrying your own water makes a big difference, especially in warmer weather.

## A finish in Fuengirola

The final stretch takes you over a bridge and into Fuengirola, where the quiet morning coastline turns into a livelier town. And honestly, what better way to finish a 15 km run than with a fresh pastry and a drink by the sea?

![The bridge and the final approach to Fuengirola.](/assets/uploads/fuengirola/fuengirola-finish.jpg "The bridge and the final approach to Fuengirola.")

## Running with company

I haven’t found an active local running club in the area yet, but I’d love to discover one for my next visit!

Runograph found these groups for a future visit. Maarja has not tried them; confirm upcoming runs and visitor arrangements directly.

### [La Costa Running Club](https://lacostarunningclub.com/)

Social coastal runs around Fuengirola and La Cala de Mijas, with changing meeting points. Check the club’s Instagram or WhatsApp for the next run.

### [CP Mijas Atletismo](https://cpmijas.es/atletismo/)

Coached athletics sessions at the Hipódromo Costa del Sol track, plus a training group in Mijas Pueblo. Contact the club about joining as a visitor.

### [Mijas Hash House Harriers](https://mijash3.squarespace.com/)

A social group welcoming walkers and runners for Sunday trails around Mijas. Routes and meeting points change; confirm the next outing with the organisers.
